item.title: Nebraska lawmaker proposes 'safe spaces' bill to limit immigration enforcement
item.description: Nebraska state Senator Margo Juarez introduces legislation to limit immigration enforcement at schools, hospitals, and courthouses amid recent detentions at the Douglas County Courthouse.

item.title: New effort to restrict bathroom access by gender draws hours of testimony
item.description: Sen. Kathleen Kauth introduced a new bill that would require public schools, colleges and state agencies to designate restrooms and locker rooms based on sex and prohibit use by the opposite sex.

item.title: Temperatures to drop with snow possible
item.description: Colder temperatures take over after today with wind chills dipping back into the negatives, followed by snow chances Saturday into Sunday
